name: Very shallow water, H0 = 0.6
setup: Very shallow water, H0 = 0.6, run to t = 20.
expect: Even further outside training. MCL guarantees positivity, not accuracy, so expect it to survive but to be visibly off.
observed: NN alone blows up. MCL-NN survives with clearly visible errors (h 3.8%, q 9%). A good example of the limiter preventing a crash without making a bad model accurate.
